description: This file implements the TaskRepository class which provides data access methods for TaskItem entities using Entity Framework Core. It includes methods to retrieve, add, update, and delete tasks from the database.

classes.name: TaskRepository
classes.description: Repository class implementing task data operations using Entity Framework Core.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a task by its unique identifier asynchronously.

methods.name: GetAllAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all tasks ordered by last update date asynchronously.

methods.name: GetAllForUserAsync
methods.description: Retrieves tasks assigned to or created by a specific user asynchronously.

methods.name: AddAsync
methods.description: Adds a new task to the database asynchronously.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing task in the database asynchronously.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a task from the database asynchronously.
